articles.title: Different Tasks, Different Timesteps: Temporal Task-Aware Quantization for Diffusion Language Models

articles.title: Omni-Woodpecker: Hallucination Correction via Evidence-Prior Rebalancing for Omni LLMs

articles.summary: 针对全能型大模型（OLLMs）跨模态幻觉问题，本文提出 Omni-Woodpecker。该方法通过证据-先验重平衡（Evidence-Prior Rebalancing）策略，在特征空间而非仅在输出端修正幻觉，有效理清了接地证据与学习先验间的耦合，提升了多模态推理的准确性。

articles.title: EvalResearchBench: Can AI Agents Build Their Own Feedback for Recursive Self-Improvement?

articles.summary: 针对递归自我提升（RSI）中评估成本过高的问题，本文探讨了智能体自我生成评估反馈的可行性。通过 EvalResearchBench 基准，研究 AI 智能体如何通过精简测试套件或自主反馈机制，替代昂贵的人工基准评估，从而加速迭代研究循环。

articles.title: Diffusion Language Models Change Speed Across Tasks and Languages

articles.title: Dual Exam: Controlled Evaluation of Multimodal Agents and World Models

articles.title: IF-MAP: Influence-Function-Inspired Agent Prioritization in Multi-Agent Systems
